checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: nine-area reswarm ownership map

impact_assessment.risks: contract: plan only, no code; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: read-only inventory plus file globs; no edits, no swarms, no tickets in Stage 1

[1/3] Plan: keep the onboarding ribbon at content height at 1280x720

impact_assessment.why: At the minimum supported viewport the flex column shrinks the cadet ribbon to 38px while its badge needs 59px, so the ribbon overlaps the top bar and clips the milestone pips.
impact_assessment.benefits: Onboarding stays readable and non-overlapping at 1280x720; no control or state changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (CSS only); regression: 31px less cockpit grid height at 720p.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first CSS contract test, before/after Playwright captures at 1280x720, and a scripted browser onboarding run that advances a milestone.

checkpoints.description: Cycle 1 verified: ribbon flex-shrink fix, screenshot pair and orbit play; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-cycle1-cadet-ribbon' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: make timed transit arrival advance the Orbital Insertion academy step once

impact_assessment.why: The cockpit's TRANSIT & ORBIT control establishes orbit on arrival but the tick path never calls _progress_tutorial('orbit'), so the academy stays on step 0 while the hint's orbit verb advances it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cockpit, CLI travel and REST time-step all share the same arrival path; the first academy reward becomes reachable without a hidden verb.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tutorial/credit XP awards could double if arrival retriggers; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock already held; state: existing TutorialState/credits fields only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first engine test with a second tick to prove a single award; full suite, mechanics captain and browser play.

checkpoints.description: Cycle 2 verified: transit arrival advances academy once, hints point at live controls; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-cycle2-transit-academy' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: persist engines-disable after a drive-manifold strike and drive the ENGINES gauge from it

impact_assessment.why: target_engines logs 'Disabled impulse thrusters (collapsed enemy evasion)' but CombatEncounter has no engine state, so the adaptive AI immediately telegraphs evade again and the next damaging action can miss; the cockpit ENGINES gauge instead shows CRIPPLED whenever the enemy braces.
impact_assessment.benefits: Subsystem strikes gain a persistent, legible effect; the telegraph stops contradicting the combat log; the gauge tells the truth.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CombatEncounter gains one additive field (old saves default false); dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: all combat rebuilds must forward the flag or it resets like gambit did (ADR-171).
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first headless reproducer and tests across two turns, legacy-save default test, before/after gauge captures, and a real browser combat play.

checkpoints.description: Cycle 3 verified: engines strike persists, AI stops evading, DRIVES gauge truthful; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-cycle3-engines-collapse' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: fix legacy precursor victory rep sign and stop dead nanite intents with shields down

impact_assessment.why: A legacy/custom Precursor Sentinel encounter (no archetype_id) awarded Precursor Watch +8 on victory, and the Warlord AI telegraphs nanite repair with its shields at zero even though the ability only works while shields hold.
impact_assessment.benefits: Enemy kills consistently punish the victim faction and the dreadnought stops wasting its special-ability turn; the victory log matches the standing delta.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (fallback string and intent policy only); dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: no new save fields; balance: warlord will fire/brace instead of a dead ability.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first probes saved before the fix, unit tests for both, before/after cockpit plays for boss intent and victory rep.

checkpoints.description: Cycle 4 verified: legacy precursor rep -8/+4 and warlord nanite gated off at zero shields; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-cycle4-enemy-rep-boss-ai' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: make gas and lava worlds landable and gate ground-only operations off gas giants

impact_assessment.why: Cloud Scoop and Magma Tap are advertised surface operations but no generated gas/ringed/ice/lava world is landable, so both are unreachable; a reachability sweep finds cloud_scoop and magma_tap on zero of 70 landable bodies.
impact_assessment.benefits: All 13 surface operations become reachable, gas worlds get an aerostat cloud-scoop loop, and lava worlds get their magma tap without offering rover operations in a cloud deck.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: landable flags are persisted, so existing saves keep old flags until a new game; balance: more landable worlds and landing rewards.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reachability test over the whole generated galaxy, gas-giant landing play, env-gating tests, before/after cockpit captures; no new save field.
